authorityClaim: This artifact NAMES the FX-13 manifest-to-grant round-trip initial states from permission-truth-tables.v9 for the seven closed-set tokens. It does not author grant records. It does not author decision records. It does not mint Run/operation identity values. It does not execute FX-13. It does not close OBL-FX-AUTHORING. It does not SATISFY DR-105. It applies nothing and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/.
purpose: Continue leftover-design of OBL-FX-AUTHORING at FX-13 without inventing grant or decision-record envelopes and without minting identity values that ride DR-006. v9 requires the chain declared-in-manifest -> requested-record -> grant record -> brokered request -> outcome -> audit binding, asserting presence and binding structure only. This catalog names that chain once per closed-set token.

pttV9.fx13Intent: For each token, assert the chain declared-in-manifest -> requested-record -> grant record -> brokered request -> outcome -> audit binding is complete and that every record binds the full tuple file 03 names (Request/Execution attempt, component/generation, process instance, operation, grant, project, scope, expiry) plus the audit binding set. Identity VALUES for Run/operation are not asserted here; they ride DR-006 (ID-DEP-P12) and the fixture asserts presence and binding structure only.
